summary: Steep residential street; homes within 25 m on both sides.

best_section.where: Mossman Street east kerb, just before the main road junction at the school zone

drivers.seclusion: Houses sit about 13 m away on the east side and across the street on the west; trees screen some.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park on the street, and the lane beside the line is wide enough for a van to stand.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, with a busier main road at the bottom end.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along this street, but no marked parking lane; a van would be noticed by neighbours.

flags: Steep: about 8.9% at the best section, 15% over the whole stretch, up to 33% locally
Houses 13 m from the east side
sun_shade: Tree canopy over the north half; the south end is partly open.
